statement_en: If a holomorphic function $f$ on an open connected subset $U$ of the complex plane is equal to $0$ on some subset $S\subset U$ having an accumulation point in $U$, then $f$ is identically zero on all of $U$.
callout_body: 如果定义在复平面上的全纯函数$f$在连通开集子集$U$的某个含有聚点(极限点)的某个子集$S\subset U$上等于0,并且聚点在$U$当中，那么函数在整个$U$上等于0.
